theme_and_brand.project_name: Digitalizing the Informal E-Waste Recycling System
theme_and_brand.archetype: Electric & Neon (Archetype 7) mixed with Swiss Brutalist Structure
theme_and_brand.overall_mood: High-tech, environmental urgency, precise, modern, dark-first SaaS.

headings.import_instructions: Import 'Outfit' from Google Fonts. Do NOT use Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.

rules: Use #111111 for dashboard sidebars and dense layout sections.
Use #1A1A1A for Bento grid cards to create subtle elevation.
Vibrant lime-green (#7CFC00) is strictly for primary CTAs, active states, active nav items, and positive trend indicators.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for headers/overlays; use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60.

bento_cards.classes: bg-[#111111] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300 shadow-sm

textures.landing_background: Implement a subtle halftone/noise overlay or blurred abstract background over the #0A0A0A base to kill digital flatness.

spacing_and_layouts.general: Use generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
spacing_and_layouts.landing_page_grid: Mode A (Tetris Grid). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8). Elements span differently (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero bento, col-span-4 for standard steps).
spacing_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use h-full so cards match neighbors perfectly.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#7CFC00] text-black font-semibold hover:bg-[#6BE000] px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: Pill-shaped, bg-white/5 text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/10 px-6 py-3 transition-colors

navigation.landing: Fixed top nav, glassmorphism applied. Links: Layouts, System, Docs, Sign In.
navigation.dashboard: Left Sidebar (bg-[#111111], border-r border-white/10). Links: Dashboard, Lifecycle, Analytics, Projects, Team, Documents. Active state uses Lime Green text + subtle left border or background tint.

kpi_cards.structure: Shadcn Card or custom div. bg-[#1A1A1A], border-white/10, p-6.
kpi_cards.contents: Title (muted, text-sm uppercase), Main Value (text-3xl text-white), Trend Indicator (text-[#7CFC00] with up arrow for positive).

forms_and_inputs.rules: Use Shadcn customized primitives. Backgrounds must be #0A0A0A or #111111. Borders white/10. Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#7CFC00].

loading_splash.layout: Full screen center aligned. Black background.
loading_splash.content: Display PS ID: Open Innovation, Title: Digitalizing the Informal E-Waste Recycling System, Theme: Clean & Technology, Team: The Null Set. Use 'React Bits CountUp component' (or react-countup) to animate stats: Kg Recycled, Active Collectors, ₹ Paid Out.

landing_page.hero: Hero section 'Build Faster / Ship with Confidence' context adapted to E-waste. Blurred mountain background + textured overlay.
landing_page.process_section: 6-Step Flow in a Bento Grid: 1. Capture photo, 2. Categorize type & weight, 3. Value price estimate, 4. Match recycler, 5. Handover record, 6. Payment earnings updated. Solid color cards with icons.
landing_page.pricing: Tiered layout with white pill CTAs.

auth.layout: Centered glass card on dark textured background with JWT logic mock.

dashboard_collector.wizard: New Listing Flow: Photo upload area, Category/Weight inputs, Rule-based price estimate showing ₹.
dashboard_collector.views: My Listings grid, Wallet/Earnings KPI summary.

dashboard_recycler.views: Browse Open Listings grid/table, Make Offer/Accept interaction, Stripe Checkout payment mock button, Handover digital record confirmation.

dashboard_admin.views: KPI metric cards, Area line chart (Recharts) for 'Kg Recycled Over Time' with #7CFC00 line, All Activity Logs Table, Users List.

image_urls.description: Macro photography of black circuit board
Modern recycling facility with scrap and machinery

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set text color and background on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties like 'transition-transform duration-300'. NEVER use 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Wrap grid items in framer-motion divs for staggered entrance animations. Ensure motion div is the direct child of the grid container.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #1A1A1A meets contrast ratios. Use #7CFC00 for large text, icons, or buttons with black text on top.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.focus: Focus states must be visible: ring-2 ring-[#7CFC00] offset-2 offset-[#0A0A0A].

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Write all Shadcn components and logic in standard React Javascript (.jsx/.js), NOT TypeScript.
Implement a Dark Mode only/first design.
Do not converge towards generic 'AI slop'. Prioritize the #111 bento and #7CFC00 aesthetic. Use deep layering and precise padding.
Do NOT apply global 'transition: all' in CSS.
Do NOT center align the root .App container in CSS.
Never use generic emojis as UI icons. Use lucide-react.
When customizing Shadcn components, ensure they map to the dark mode palette. Strip out generic defaults.
Every dynamic listing, metric, or user row must be mapped from dummy data. Show ₹ currency for all financial values.
Do not use placeholders for images. Always map to the provided image URLs.
